changelog: Settings entry fixed for real: the host's settings destination sits in a FragmentContainerView, whose addView() rejects any view that is not a fragment root (IllegalStateException). Every earlier attempt (row and fallback entry) was silently thrown away by that check. The entry now attaches to the window's content container, lifted above the bottom navigation bar, while the settings list is shortened by exactly one row - so the row lands right under the list.
The same rejection is now impossible for the fallback entry, which previously targeted the same container and therefore never appeared either.
Removed the container helpers that could only ever fail on a fragment container.
